integrity: The analytical proof supports all stated quantifiers and asymptotics. Numerical cross-checks are not used as infinite proof. The originality judgment is based on the available primary sections and database comparisons, subject to the documented inaccessible 2009 full text.
scientific_limitations: Nearest-neighbor finite cycles with unnormalized counting norms and mean-zero data. Eventual uniqueness is proved, but no explicit smallest uniqueness size is asserted. The closed variational formula is related to earlier parameterized Green inequalities; possible unindexed equivalent finite-size asymptotics remain a literature risk.
title: Fractional finite-size defect in sharp cyclic Sobolev interpolation
